title: Edit global blockchain parameters
description: Propose new global parameters for the BitShares blockchain. Changes apply at maintenance after committee approval.
pendingNote: This operation must travel inside a committee proposal with a sufficient review period, and takes effect at chain maintenance once approved — never immediately.
gateNotLoggedIn: You are not logged in, so you are unable to affect these changes. Select an account to continue.
gateNotMember: Your account is not a committee member, so you are unable to affect these changes.
gateInactive: Your account is not an active committee member, so you are unable to affect these changes.
loadFailed: Failed to load current parameters. Check your node connection and retry.
proposeInfo: This operation can only travel inside a committee proposal. The review period must be at least the current committee review period.
feesDesc: Network fee per operation in BTS, plus per-kilobyte surcharge where shown.
h_maintenance_interval: Seconds; must exceed the block interval and be a multiple of it.
h_committee_proposal_review_period: Seconds; lifetime minus review must exceed the block interval.
h_maximum_time_until_expiration: Seconds; must exceed the block interval.
h_maximum_proposal_lifetime: Seconds; lifetime minus review must exceed the block interval.
h_network_percent_of_fee: Percent to network, 0 to 100; network plus referrer must not exceed 100.
h_lifetime_referrer_percent_of_fee: Percent to referrer, 0 to 100; network plus referrer must not exceed 100.
h_cashback_vesting_threshold: BTS receivable without vesting (up to 5 decimals).
h_witness_pay_vesting_seconds: Seconds before witness pay becomes liquid.
h_fee_liquidation_threshold: BTS at which accumulated asset fees are liquidated (up to 5 decimals).
f_cauth_max_custom_authorities_per_accou: Maximum custom authorities per account operation
err_badBts: Enter a BTS amount (up to 5 decimals).
err_badBlockInterval: Block interval must be between 1 and 30 seconds.
err_crossMaintenance: Maintenance interval must exceed the block interval and be a multiple of it.
err_crossExpiration: Must be greater than the block interval.
err_crossLifetime: Proposal lifetime minus review period must exceed the block interval.
err_crossFeeSplit: Network and referrer shares together must not exceed 100%.
feeFixed: Fixed by the protocol — not editable.
feeVirtualNote: Virtual operation, emitted by the blockchain itself — there is no fee to set.
h_count_non_member_votes: When on, votes from basic accounts count in witness, committee and worker elections; when off, only lifetime members decide.
h_allow_non_member_whitelists: When on, basic accounts may maintain their own account whitelists and blacklists; when off, only lifetime members can. Asset-level whitelist authorities are unaffected.
extRemoveWarn: Disabling removes these options from the chain parameters.
pendingExistsNote: A staged parameter set from an earlier proposal exists — editing starts from those values so they are not overwritten.
